## Contributor Checklist

Please check all applicable boxes before submitting:

- [ ] **Tested in Gemini Spark**: I have tested this prompt/skill/workflow in the Gemini Spark interface and verified its output.
- [ ] **Sanitized / No Secrets**: I have ensured NO personal data (names, real emails, private contents) or secrets (API keys, passwords) are present. All examples use bracketed placeholders (e.g. `[YOUR_EMAIL]`).
- [ ] **Template Compliant**: My submission follows the appropriate structure in `templates/`.
- [ ] **Correct Directory & Naming**: The file is placed in `tasks/`, `skills/`, `workflows/`, or `setup/` using `kebab-case.md`.
- [ ] **Table Index Updated**: If adding a new task, skill, or workflow, I have added it to the corresponding table in `README.md` or directory index.
- [ ] **Code of Conduct**: I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
